blockingFindings.title: R1 stale cache scenario is not exercised
blockingFindings.issue: createPluginRepo() creates both first and second commits before cloneCache() runs, so the managed cache is cloned at the latest remote default branch commit. The test can pass without fetching or updating a stale cache HEAD, which is the behavior R1 is meant to prove.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Create the managed cache while the remote default branch is still at the old commit, then advance the remote and assert update-all adopts the newly fetched default branch commit.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a static anti-pattern that would pass without exercising the required production behavior for unresolved Git URL refs.

blockingFindings.title: R2 only covers branch refs
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires deterministic resolution for branch, tag, and SHA-equivalent refs, but the spec-local test only covers a branch ref.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local executable coverage for at least tag and SHA ref resolution, including the expected resolved commit.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Parts of the acceptance requirement have no corresponding spec-local regression coverage.
